purpose: Inputs for a separate upstream candidate generator -> Jev local-relation batch -> strong host investigation stage; not scientific reference answers.

rules.ranking: SHA256(seed + NUL + relative_path); owners and families ranked by same function on their identifiers
rules.coverage: For each content type, round-robin owners; within owner round-robin directory families; within family take next ranked eligible file. Skip exhausted owners/families. UTF-8 and no NUL required; check selected bytes against frozen SHA256.
rules.family_rule: cxekr/artifacts/experiment/<directory>; other cxekr/<first directory>; cxekr_loop/<first directory>; otherwise owner/root
rules.exclusions: Non-allowlisted formats, <256 or >120000 bytes, hidden/cache components, non-UTF8/NUL. No symlink traversal; source manifest only.

limitations: Directory/format balancing is purposeful nonrandom sampling and overrepresents small owners relative to file population.
Structured text includes metadata/configuration as well as numerical results; extension does not establish evidence quality.
Path/family coverage is not scientific coverage; related definitions may fall outside sample. Missing links cannot prove absence in full A.
Size restriction excludes long raw logs, binary trajectories and PDFs. This stage tests local relation proposal/selection, not full scientific reconstruction.
Curator has prior scientific exposure; deterministic selection uses no semantic judgments, but overall case itself is previously exposed.
No scientific summaries or reference answers supplied; downstream actual read set must be checked separately against this list.

completion_scope_audit.previous_completed: The selected-case host-led reconstruction, package/source handoff, B revision/history preservation and bounded cold continuation; initial failures and revealed repairs retained.
completion_scope_audit.previous_not_tested: Program or cheap generation worker proposes candidates first, then Jev batch local relations, then strong host selects investigations.
completion_scope_audit.prior_three_arm_comparison: Nonrandom and unequal-budget phase evidence, not validation of the new upstream information flow or Jev incremental value.
